endonym.gloss: the place we came down to

description.value: A wet, storm-driven world under a bright white star, three quarters ocean, with an obliquity of forty-one degrees that gives it seasons of a severity nobody on it pretends to be relaxed about. The southern continent carries high canopy forest on a staircase of uplifted terraces; the northern coast is worked by a storm belt that migrates nine hundred kilometres over the year. Contact was suspended in 2298 following an ethics ruling on the tether works, and the world is now studied from orbit only.
Moker in nevihten svet z ostrimi letnimi časi; stik je od leta 2298 prekinjen.

Um mundo húmido e batido por tempestades sob uma estrela branca e brilhante, três quartos oceano, com uma obliquidade de quarenta e um graus que lhe dá estações de uma severidade perante a qual ninguém ali finge estar descontraído. O continente do sul tem floresta de dossel alto assente numa escadaria de terraços soerguidos; a costa norte é trabalhada por um cinturão de tempestades que migra novecentos quilómetros ao longo do ano. O contacto foi suspenso em 2298 na sequência de uma decisão ética sobre as obras do cabo orbital, e o mundo é agora estudado apenas a partir de órbita.

atmosphere.value: Nitrogen and oxygen at 1.31 bar, wet, with a strong ultraviolet flux from the primary. Comfortable to breathe and very hard on unprotected eyes.

biosphere.value: Life is present: 3 catalogued species (Hundred Stairs Terrace Builders, Overfall Canopy Weave, Weather Coast Net Keepers) and 1 recorded non-sapient organism. The survey is not claimed to be complete.

notes.value: The suspension file runs to nineteen hundred pages, of which eleven hundred concern the question of who asked for the tether and in what words.
